title: GitHub Agentic Workflows
description: A scenario-led briefing on secure, governed agentic automation for software delivery.
audience: technical leaders, platform engineers, security teams, and developers
learningObjectives: Explain the security, supply-chain, and operational risks of wiring agent CLIs or actions directly into CI.
Identify written Markdown intent and the declarative controls that constrain an agentic workflow.
Apply a deterministic-first execution model that invokes an agent only when reasoning is necessary.
Use budgets, timeouts, rate limits, and concurrency controls to govern cost and execution volume.
Design staged safe outputs and observable outcomes that support review, audit, and value measurement.

validators.name: gh-aw workflow compiler
validators.command: gh aw compile examples/repo-care.md --dir examples --no-emit --validate --strict --schedule-seed demo/gh-agentic-workflows --no-check-update
